title: Rounded edges: tangent lines on the SMARS range finder cover
why: The cover's ends are half circles and its rim is filleted: every facet turns only a few degrees, so no fold reaches the 30° crease. An illustrator shows each round with its tangent lines, a thin line where a flat face turns into the curve, so there are vertical lines where the front meets each rounded end and a double line round the filleted rim, and nothing on the plain curved surfaces between them.
